title: D05-W01 Welcome — customer-facing artifact
subject: Welcome to AVGAR
preview: Thanks for joining AVGAR. Here's where to start.
body:
Hi {{first_name|there}},

Welcome to AVGAR.

AVGAR makes golf travel and on-course accessories. When you're ready, browse the store and find the gear that fits your game.

Shop AVGAR: https://avgarsport.com

Thanks for being here,
AVGAR
